e.g. euphoric hardstyle, distorted kick, supersaw leads

\"Download over Wi-Fi only\" is on and the phone is not on Wi-Fi - connect to Wi-Fi or change the setting.
The models of this configuration take %1$s in the phone storage after download. Results and temporary files: about %2$s. Free now: %3$s.

Model %1$s needs about %2$.1f GB of RAM at peak (weights %3$.1f GB + work memory for %4$.0f s of audio). Phone: %5$.1f GB RAM, %6$.1f GB free now. Your limit: %7$.1f GB.
The language model step needs about %1$.1f GB (runs before the music model, not at the same time).
Estimate - it becomes exact after the first run on this phone.
Measured on this phone during earlier runs.
Fits in your limit - the whole track is computed in one pass.
To stay within your limit, the app will work in passes of at most %1$.0f s and use %2$d thread(s). It takes longer, but will not stop because of memory.
The language model is switched off (it does not fit in the limit).

Your limit is lower than the model weights alone. The app will still run: shortest passes, at most 2 threads, and if Android stops the engine for lack of memory, the app waits for free memory and continues from the last finished pass. Expect it to be much slower; a smaller quantization (e.g. Q4_K_M) is recommended.

Generating music uses the processor at full load for a long time (minutes to hours). The phone may get hot and the battery will drain quickly - keep it charging, out of direct sun and without a case. Overheating protection: %1$s.
on - the app pauses when the phone gets too hot

I understand the download size, storage and memory use and the risk of overheating

RAM limit for generation: %1$.1f GB (phone: %2$.1f GB)

Not on Wi-Fi and \"Wi-Fi only\" is on.

Out of memory in step \'%1$s\' (attempt %2$d) - continuing with fewer threads, shorter passes and without the language model.

By default audio goes to Music/ACE_music_gen and MIDI, notation and metadata to Download/ACE_music_gen, in a folder per track (no permission needed). You can pick your own folder for every kind of file - the app then saves into <folder>/<track>/. If a picked folder becomes unavailable, the default is used and the log says so.
No access to this folder any more - the default location will be used. Pick it again.
Results: audio → Music/ACE_music_gen, MIDI and notation → Download/ACE_music_gen. Change in Settings → Save locations.
Results: your folders for %1$d kind(s) of files, the rest in the default locations (Settings → Save locations).
No access to the picked folder for: %1$s - saved in the default location instead.
Free space for results and temporary files (internal storage): %1$s
The storage chosen for the models is not available (SD card removed?). Insert it or choose another location on the Models tab.
The engine reads models directly from files, so Android only allows the app\'s own folders here (no access to your other files is needed). You can move downloaded models between them.
No SD card found. If you insert one, it will appear here.
Models in these folders are deleted when the app is uninstalled. To keep a copy, save the .gguf files elsewhere and bring them back with \"Import models\".
Wait until generation finishes to change the location.
Internal app storage (private, not visible over USB)
Phone storage, app folder (Android/data, visible over USB) - default
SD card (%1$s), app folder - slower to load
Move the downloaded models there (%1$s to copy, %2$s free)? If you keep them where they are, the app will download the models again in the new location when needed.
No models are downloaded yet. New downloads will go to this location.
Move cancelled - the models stay where they were.

Copy .gguf model files you already have (e.g. downloaded on a computer from the source above) into the model folder - no second download. Files are checked against the official size and checksum when known.
Some files are not in the official list, so they could not be verified; the app only uses files with the expected names.
%1$s is not a .gguf model file - skipped.
Generates only when the phone has nothing else to do. Slowest, the phone stays fully smooth.
Default. Other apps get the processor first, the phone stays smooth.
Same priority as other apps. Faster, the phone may stutter while generating.
Generation takes precedence over other apps. Faster, but the phone may become sluggish. If the system refuses, the engine runs at Normal (see Log).
Highest priority Android allows an app (true real-time scheduling is reserved for the system). The phone may barely respond and heat up quickly; overheating protection still applies.
Tell us if a result is offensive, harmful or infringes someone\'s rights. The report contains the reason, your comment, the model and the description - not the audio or your files.
Thank you. Finish sending the report in the app that opened.
